newsitem.title: SPAIN: Montoro says Spain among top EMU candidates.
newsitem.headline: Montoro says Spain among top EMU candidates.

text.p: Spanish Economy Secretary Cristobal Montoro said on Friday that Spain is one of the strongest candidates for the planned 1999 launch of the European common currency.

"We have been getting a series of good news, which together with the labour market reform agreement, builds confidence in Spain and confirms us as one of the strongest candidates for EMU launch," Montoro told journalists.
Montoro also said the Bank of Spain's interest rate cut
this morning by 25 basis points to 5.75 percent was a response to a sharp improvement in inflation.
The fall in inflation "strengthens the idea that Spain is in a process of European convergence that is ever more solid."
With respect to possible future interest rate cuts, Montoro said "as inflation and the public deficit confirm their declines, we will certainly see more interest rate declines."
